text: Implemented executable JVM MotionCli runner: estimate writes report bundle, apply parses motion TSV and writes corrected NIfTI plus sidecar, run estimates/applies and writes corrected image plus reports, and report regenerates bundle outputs from TSV. Added TSV estimate parser and end-to-end CLI runner test over synthetic NIfTI. Updated README/plan/closeout ledger. Verified motionJVM/test (89), motionJS/test (77), and git diff --check for touched motion files.
